triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cnine_sync_insert_v1 AFTER INSERT ON public.cnine_user_inventory REFERENCING NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_account_sync_stamp_v1('user_id', 'inventory')

CREATE TRIGGER cnine_sync_update_v1 AFTER UPDATE ON public.cnine_user_inventory REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_account_sync_stamp_v1('user_id', 'inventory')

CREATE TRIGGER cnine_sync_delete_v1 AFTER DELETE ON public.cnine_user_inventory REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_account_sync_stamp_v1('user_id', 'inventory')
